reason: A £4.95 trial with free delivery that comes off the first pouch is cheap enough that I'd try it, and a halal certificate I can actually check beats the vague claims on most Amazon tubs. I'd only get the trial this month though, not commit to a full pouch yet.
objection: £18 for 300g is steep when I can get a 500g tub of collagen on Amazon for about the same on a Prime Day deal, and the pitch is all skin, hair and biotin when I mainly want it for my joints and recovery.
